name: Scythosuchus
isnote: PBDB places it in Vjushkovisaurini (Rauisuchidae); the group is not in the atlas as a clade; placed in Paracrocodylomorpha.
sum: Scythosuchus is a rauisuchid from the Early Triassic (Olenekian) of Russia.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
